description: Source-of-truth catalog for public AI ERP Demo contracts. Every OpenAPI or business-event contract must be listed here with status, owner, safety boundary, and verification.

contracts.safety_boundary: Draft-only AI proposal API. The control plane cannot carry ERP mutation instructions and cannot post money, stock, payroll, permissions, or compliance changes.

contracts.producer: future connector or Frappe job implementation
contracts.safety_boundary: Notification-only business events with minimal non-PII payloads. Events do not authorize ERP mutations for money, stock, payroll, permission, or compliance state and contain no customer contact data, addresses, prompts, credentials, ledger lines, or mutation instructions.
